notes.title: Another fix for the "Complete the Entire Game" achievement
notes.content:
Added an additional check to the Title screen to make sure you've both started the game and completed the game, before triggering the achievement.
 Entering the last cutscene should immediately trigger the achievement now.

notes.title: Update notes for June 12, 2024
notes.content:
Interwoven Emotions is live -- thanks everyone for playing and for your wonderful feedback!

Some players reported that they were unable to see the achievement So proud of you, you did it! which should trigger at the end of the last cutscene after completing all levels on all difficulties. This has been fixed, so a full playthrough should trigger this achievement as we intended. If you already completed the game, fear not - as long as you have not  cleared your save data, then the next time you load the game and land on the title screen, you should see the achievement immediately.

Happy June!
- Secondhand Gnome
